basis: Direct calls at EE 0x0018AA74 and 0x0018BE38 target 0x0018B4F0. The leaf returns to its caller with a signed word load from the first argument plus four bytes in its delay slot. The behavioural name describes the access, not a recovered retail symbol.
build_command: python ps2/workflow.py verify sles-53287-online ps2/local/disc/SC3_ON.ELF --unit read-second-word
